eyebrow: A client-tool convention, not a MySQL feature
code:
-- The MySQL SERVER has no idea DELIMITER exists.
-- A Python/Java/.NET driver sends the whole body as one
-- string -- there's no CLI prompt for it to confuse.
caption: You will never see DELIMITER in application code, only in CLI scripts.
MySQL uses CALL. T-SQL uses EXEC. Small difference, easy to forget.
